Codex review: needs maintainer review before merge. ## What this changes This PR adds matching diagrams to Android and iOS screenshot fixtures and waits for rendered diagram accessibility elements before capture. **Example:** Capture the native chat screenshot containing Draft → Review → Ship. - **Before:** The scene contains no diagram and readiness checks cannot establish successful diagram rendering. - **After:** The scene includes the flowchart and capture waits for the renderer’s Mermaid diagram element. ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | The patch is focused and source-consistent, with supporting test claims but incomplete native qualification. | | **Proof confidence** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | This maintainer-authored fixture PR is outside the ordinary contributor proof gate; its reported tests and synthetic ADB probe support the change, while the inspected linked screenshots demonstrate web rendering rather than the native capture paths. | | **Patch quality** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | No actionable review findings were identified. | ## Product **Kind:** Test only · **Worth it:** Yes · **Fix scope:** Complete **User problem:** Native screenshot captures cannot qualify diagram rendering when their chat fixtures contain no diagram. **Reason:** Maintainer authorship establishes direction, and the change adds meaningful native rendering coverage without expanding the product surface. ## Merge readiness ✅ **Ready for maintainer review** Keep open: this maintainer-authored draft adds useful native screenshot coverage for the linked renderer migration, and no definite introduced code defect was found. **Priority:** P3 **Reviewed head:** `d9dbf4d1dc3ed477743a30ef4f224b5f3824161c` ## Before merge None. ## Findings None. ### Tests - Missing end-to-end proof: The recorded draft hold still needs Android and iOS native captures showing the seeded flowchart after successful rendering, including Apple Swift/WebKit execution; these were not demonstrated by the reported tests or synthetic ADB probe.
Agent review details ### How this fits together Local screenshot fixtures supply synthetic chat messages to the native production renderers; Android ADB checks and iOS UI tests determine when store screenshots can be captured. ```mermaid flowchart LR A[Synthetic chat fixtures] --> B[Native chat views] B --> C[Production diagram renderer] C --> D[Accessible rendered image] D --> E[Screenshot readiness checks] E --> F[Store screenshots] ``` ### Technical review Best possible solution: Keep diagram fixtures and successful-render waits in the existing screenshot owners, separate from the renderer replacement. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? This is a coverage improvement rather than a reported product malfunction; source inspection confirms that the original screenshot scenes lacked diagrams. Is this the best way to solve the issue? The diff is a small, complete extension of existing fixture and readiness owners, with no redundant renderer, wrapper, state, or test scaffolding. AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning medium; reviewed against [b7861d6b56cd](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b7861d6b56cd3897637282c8a93fb5bc8572e0f0). ### Provenance checked - `iOS screenshot fixture separation` keeps the original intent (377f6181a91b5e541360859ded9371799667e418: Provide local screenshot fixture behavior separately from Apple Review demo behavior.) - `Android deterministic screenshot readiness` keeps the original intent (f163f32f850c9df40a7ec8d06fce4f2d81e2c56a: Capture production screens with deterministic local fixtures and wait for scene readiness.) - `iOS composer interaction before capture` keeps the original intent (https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/120723: Ensure tapping the composer retains keyboard focus and permits typing before screenshot capture.) - `Android latest-reply fixture content` keeps the original intent (68ec50d643383090974fa89fc15b7e22efecb4fe: Show a conversation in the screenshot fixture rather than an empty chat.) ### Testing Proof path: unit tests only. ### Security None. ### Evidence What I checked: - **Pinned introduced change:** The introduced diff changes only fixture messages and existing capture readiness checks; comparing these paths with fetched main confirms that the additions remain absent from main. ([d9dbf4d1dc3e](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d9dbf4d1dc3ed477743a30ef4f224b5f3824161c)) - **Android readiness matches renderer output:** ChatMermaidBlock exposes the Mermaid diagram content description only for a successful rendered bitmap; the new phone-chat check therefore excludes loading and source-only output. ([`apps/android/app/src/main/java/ai/openclaw/app/ui/chat/ChatMermaidBlock.kt:135`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/d9dbf4d1dc3ed477743a30ef4f224b5f3824161c/apps/android/app/src/main/java/ai/openclaw/app/ui/chat/ChatMermaidBlock.kt#L135), [d9dbf4d1dc3e](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d9dbf4d1dc3ed477743a30ef4f224b5f3824161c)) - **Apple readiness matches renderer output:** ChatMermaidBlockView labels its successful rendered-image button Mermaid diagram, matching the added UI-test wait while preserving the existing composer-focus check. ([`apps/shared/OpenClawKit/Sources/OpenClawChatUI/ChatMermaidBlockView.swift:92`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/d9dbf4d1dc3ed477743a30ef4f224b5f3824161c/apps/shared/OpenClawKit/Sources/OpenClawChatUI/ChatMermaidBlockView.swift#L92), [d9dbf4d1dc3e](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d9dbf4d1dc3ed477743a30ef4f224b5f3824161c)) - **Fixture boundaries preserved:** The iOS empty-chat branch still returns no seed messages, and the separate Apple Review demo fixture is unchanged. ([`apps/ios/Sources/Chat/AppleReviewDemoChatTransport.swift:107`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/d9dbf4d1dc3ed477743a30ef4f224b5f3824161c/apps/ios/Sources/Chat/AppleReviewDemoChatTransport.swift#L107), [d9dbf4d1dc3e](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d9dbf4d1dc3ed477743a30ef4f224b5f3824161c)) - **Linked renderer work and inspected media:** https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184482 targets this PR’s head as its base and explicitly distinguishes its mobile-web screenshots from pending native qualification; all four prepared images were inspected and show web diagrams rather than the changed native fixtures. - **Current workflow state:** GitHub confirms the reviewed head remains a cleanly mergeable draft authored by a collaborator; the body records native qualification as pending.
